verse.text: His divine power has given us everything we need for a godly life through our knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and goodness.

reflection.scripture: His divine power has given us everything we need for a godly life through our knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and goodness.
reflection.observation: Peter reminds us that we don't have to strive for godliness in our own strength. God's divine power — the same power that raised Christ from the dead — is actively at work in us. This isn't about mustering up more willpower or checking off spiritual disciplines. It's about knowing Jesus deeply. The more we know Him, the more His power transforms us from the inside out. Everything we need has already been given.
reflection.application: Today, when I feel inadequate or like I'm falling short, I'll pause and remember: I already have everything I need. Not because I'm enough, but because He is. I'll choose one area where I've been striving in my own strength and intentionally surrender it to His power.
reflection.prayer: Lord, thank You that I don't have to do this alone. Your divine power is at work in me right now. Help me stop striving and start trusting. Draw me into deeper knowledge of You today — not just facts about You, but intimate, life-changing relationship. In Jesus' name, amen.
